text:
Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear Team Member,

I am writing to address some concerns that have been brought to our attention regarding your recent workplace behavior. It has come to our notice that there have been multiple complaints about your conduct, which does not align with our company’s core values.

We value a respectful and professional work environment for everyone. Therefore, we expect an immediate improvement in your behavior and strict adherence to our professional standards moving forward.

Please let me know if you would like to discuss this matter further or if you need any support in making these adjustments.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
